topics.title: Whole Numbers - Identification and Reading of Number 6 - 9 and 9 - 6 Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Mathematics
topics.content:
MATHEMATICS
FIRST TERM
WEEK 5
PRIMARY 1
THEME - NUMBER AND NUMERATION
PREVIOUS LESSON - Whole Number 0 (Zero) - Introducing Zero (0) As A Number (Primary 1)
TOPIC - IDENTIFICATION AND READING OF NUMBER OF OBJECTS 6 - 9
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities
2. Sort and Classify Numbers of Objects in a Group or Collection
2. Counting Number 1 - 9
3. Read and Write Number 1 - 9
4. Arrange the number 1 - 9
PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most of the pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. sort and classify numbers of objects in a group or collection.
2. identify number of objects in a group or collection.
3. count and read correctly from 1 - 9.
4. write correctly number 6 - 9.
5. arrange the numbers 6 - 9 in order of their magnitudes (quantities).
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
Counting and reading of numbers.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of counters such as
1. Counters: balls, pebbles, buttons, bottle tops, leaves and oranges etc.
2. Flash cards of numbers 1 - 9, etc.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information -

LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTORY ACTIVITIES
SORTING AND CLASSIFYING OBJECTS LEADING TO IDEA OF 6 - 9

Teacher’s/Pupil’s Activities - Present group of objects for the pupils to sort and count, then pick the corresponding flash card number 1 - 9 as follows -

LESSON 2 - READ AND WRITING OF NUMBERS 1 - 9/9 - 1
Teacher’s Activities - Guides pupils to read the numbers 1 - 9 on the flash card or board.
Pupil’s Activities -
Read - 1  2  3  4  5  6  7  8  9
Read - 9  8  7  6  5  4  3  2  1
ORDERING NUMBER 1 - 9/9 - 1
Teacher’s Activities - Asks the pupils to arrange the following cards in order 1 - 9.
6  3  7  9  1  4  8  2  5
Pupil’s Activities -
Order, 1 - 9
1  2  3  4  5  6  7  8  9
Order, 9 - 1
9  8  7  6  5  4  3  2  1
PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Guides pupils to mix the collection and sort out books, keys, pencils, rulers and biro together.
Pupil’s Activities - Sort and classify the mixed collection e.g. Collection of books, keys, pencils, rulers and biro.
3. Guides pupils to classify each group of similar objects as follows.
- Count out five pencils.
- Add one pencil to it.
4. Leads pupils to recognize this as 6 i.e. 5 pencils and 1 pencil gives 6.
5. Counts out 6 pencils and adds 1 pencil to it and leads them to recognize it as 7 up to 9 buttons etc.
Pupil’s Activities - Identify the numbers 6 - 9 through the activities and the use of Flash cards.
6. Guides pupils to read the numbers 1 - 9.
Pupil’s Activities - Count and read numbers 1 - 9 on the board and Flash cards.
7. Guides pupils to write the numbers 1 - 9.
Pupil’s Activities - Write the numbers 1 - 9.
8. Arranges the numbers in order of their magnitude using objects such as balls, pebbles, etc. in a collection.
9. Leads pupils to write the numbers in order of their magnitudes.
Pupil’s Activities - Use collection of objects to arrange numbers in magnitude or in ordering form.
CONCLUSION
- To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
- Next Lesson - Whole Number 10 (Primary 1)
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to -
1. arrange given number of objects from a collection together.

MATHEMATICS
SECOND TERM
WEEK 1
PRIMARY 1
THEME - NUMBER AND NUMERATOR
PREVIOUS LESSON - First Term Examination Mathematics Primary 1 (Basic 1) - Exam Questions
TOPIC - COUNTING AND WRITING 1 - 70
LEARNING AREA
1. Introductory Activities (Math Fact)
2. Count and Write 1 - 70
3. Order Numbers from 1 - 70/70 - 1
4. Lesson Evaluation and Weekly Assessment (Test)
LEARNING OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. count and write 1 - 70.
2. order numbers from 1 - 70/70 - 1.
3. count and write numbers in groups.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can count and write 1 - 10.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. Counters - stones, beans, bottle tops, buttons, leaves, nylon bags, number cards, etc.
2. Flash cards of numbers, etc.
METHOD OF TEACHING

Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.

7. Guides pupils to count and write in 1s, 2s, 3s, etc.

Pupil’s Activities - Answer most of the questions correctly.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
Addition of Numbers with Sum not more 20.
LESSON EVALUATION
Ask pupils to:
1. count and write 1 - 70.
2. order numbers from 1 - 70/70 - 1.
3. count and write numbers in groups.

MATHEMATICS
FIRST TERM
WEEK 1
PRIMARY 1
THEME -  WHOLE NUMBERS
PREVIOUS LESSON -
TOPIC - WHOLE NUMBERS FROM 1 - 10
LEARNING AREA
1. Introduction
2. Counting of numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
3. Identification and reading of numbers from 1 - 10.
4. Ordering of numbers up to 10.
v. Writing numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
LEARNING OBJECTIVES
By the end of the lesson, most pupils should have attained the following objectives -
1. count correctly from 1 - 10.
2. identify and read numbers from 1 - 10.
3. sort and classify numbers of objects on number 1 - 10.
4. identify, order and write numbers up to 10.
ENTRY BEHAVIOUR
The pupils can count and read whole numbers from 1 - 10.
INSTRUCTIONAL MATERIALS
The teacher will teach the lesson with the aid of:
1. Counters: balls, pebbles, buttons, bottle tops, leaves and oranges etc.
2. Flash cards of numbers 1 - 10.
METHOD OF TEACHING
Choose a suitable and appropriate methods for the lessons.
Note - Irrespective of choosing methods of teaching, always introduce an activities that will arouse pupil’s interest or lead them to the lessons.
REFERENCE MATERIALS
1. Scheme of Work
2. 9 - Years Basic Education Curriculum
3. Course Book
4. All Relevant Material
5. Online Information
CONTENT OF THE LESSON
LESSON 1 - INTRODUCTION
Numbers that we can use to count things are called counting numbers, for example 1, 2, 3, and so on. They are also called natural numbers.

PRESENTATION
To deliver the lesson, the teacher adopts the following steps:
1. To introduce the lesson, the teacher revises the previous lesson. Based on this, he/she asks the pupils some questions;
2. Teacher organizes the pupils in groups or pair depending on the size of the class.
3. Teacher displays chart showing numbers 1 - 10.
4. Teacher leads the pupils as groups to identify number chart.
Pupil’s Activities - The pupils identify the number 1 - 10 chart.
5. Teacher uses the chart and the pupils relevant responses to introduce the lesson.
Pupil’s Activities - The pupils pay attention to the lesson introduction.
6. Teacher leads the pupils as groups to count numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
Pupil’s Activities - The pupils count numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
7. Teacher guides identifies and reads numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
Pupil’s Activities - The pupils identify and read numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
8. Teacher displays different objects in group of 1 - 10. For example, one ball, two pencils, three rulers, etc. and asks the pupils in groups to sort and count.
Pupils Activities - The pupils sort and classify objects leading to idea of 1 - 10.
9. Teacher guides the pupils write numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
Pupils Activities - The pupils write numbers from 1 - 10 and 10 - 1.
10. Teacher summarizes the lesson on the board with appropriate evaluation.
Pupil’s Activities - The pupils participate actively in the summary of the lesson by responding correctly to most of the questions write as instructed.
CONCLUSION
To conclude the lesson for the week, the teacher revises the entire lesson and links it to the following week’s lesson.
NEXT LESSON
LESSON EVALUATION
Teacher asks pupils to,
1. count correctly from 1 - 10.
2. identify and read numbers from 1 - 10.
3. sort and classify numbers of objects on number 1 - 10.
4. identify, order and write numbers up to 10.
WEEKLY ASSESSMENT
ATTEMPT ALL THE QUESTIONS
1. Write numbers 1 - 10.
2. Write numbers 10 - 1.
3.  Count and write the number of objects.
